notes: Validated against Kim JN et al. Nat Chem Biol 2011. DG riboswitch from Mesoplasma florum. Ligand GNG (2-deoxyguanosine) at A:120. Key selectivity: 2-OH absent (deoxy) — aptamer evolved to exclude guanosine. Chain A used. MG, CCC, SIN, SO4 removed. GTP A:22 (5-terminal) included in receptor. Note: 3SKI has two chains (A,B) both with GNG — chain A selected.
